subject.title: fix(telegram): clear reasoning preview before forceNewMessage rotation (#80862)

question: Should this Telegram streaming PR wait for redacted live Telegram proof, or should a maintainer explicitly accept the source-level proof gap?
rationale: The code and regression test match the source-level bug, but scoped Telegram policy requires real Telegram proof for streaming behavior and the PR body says no live Telegram run was performed.

options.title: Collect live Telegram proof
options.body: Use Telegram Desktop, Mantis, or an equivalent redacted live run to show the old reasoning preview clears and the next preview appears before merge.

options.title: Accept source-level proof
options.body: A maintainer may intentionally merge on source-level proof and tests while owning the remaining live-transport uncertainty.

recommendation.title: Collect live Telegram proof
recommendation.body: Use Telegram Desktop, Mantis, or an equivalent redacted live run to show the old reasoning preview clears and the next preview appears before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame and recent Telegram carry/refactor history make this the best available proof-sufficiency routing candidate.
